exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  A is cooking    11  B has
   2  C any           12  A glass
   3  B on            13  C is studying
   4  C How many      14  B much
   5  A lives         15  A isn't snowing
   6  B few           16  C knives
   7  B Is she        17  A working
   8  A some          18  A a little
   9  C piece         19  C wears
  10  A tomatoes      20  C some


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (Unit 7) —
     1, 7, 13, 15, 17
  PRESENT SIMPLE (Unit 7) — 5, 11, 19
  SOME / ANY (Unit 8) — 2, 8, 20
  HOW MUCH / HOW MANY (Unit 8) — 4, 14
  A FEW / A LITTLE (Unit 8) — 6, 18
  O'LChOV BIRLIKLARI (Unit 8) — 9, 12
  KO'PLIK ShAKLLARI (Unit 8) — 10, 16
  VAQT PREDLOGI (Unit 5) — 3


──── PRESENT CONTINUOUS ↔ PRESENT
SIMPLE ────

  ⚠ KALIT SO'ZLARGA QARANG:

  CONTINUOUS ko'rsatkichlari:
     at the moment, now, today,
     this week, Look!, Listen!

  SIMPLE ko'rsatkichlari:
     every night, usually, always,
     often, never

  DOIMIY holat ham SIMPLE:
     'Yuko LIVES in Japan.' (5-band)


  CONTINUOUS bandlar:
     1  'at the moment' → IS COOKING
     7  'at the moment' → IS SHE
    13  'this week' → IS STUDYING
    15  'today' → ISN'T SNOWING
    17  'today' → ARE you WORKING

  SIMPLE bandlar:
     5  doimiy holat → LIVES
    11  'every night' → HAS
    19  'usually' → WEARS


⚠ 11 va 1-BANDLAR — 'HAVE' NING IKKI ROLI:

   1  'She IS COOKING dinner at the
       moment.' → Continuous
  11  'She HAS a shower every night.'
       → Simple ('every night')

  ⚠ 'have a shower' — HARAKAT, shuning
  uchun Continuous ham bo'lishi mumkin
  edi. Lekin 'every night' — DOIMIY odat,
  demak SIMPLE.


──── SANALADIGAN ↔ SANALMAYDIGAN ────

  ⚠ TO'LIQ JADVAL:

     SANALADIGAN (ko'plikda):
        eggs, biscuits, tomatoes, knives,
        apples
        → HOW MANY, A FEW, SOME/ANY

     SANALMAYDIGAN:
        bread, milk, tea, sugar, water
        → HOW MUCH, A LITTLE, SOME/ANY


   4  'How MANY EGGS ...?' — sanaladigan
  14  'How MUCH TEA ...?' — sanalmaydigan

   6  'a FEW BISCUITS' — sanaladigan
  18  'a LITTLE SUGAR' — sanalmaydigan


⚠ SOME / ANY — UCh HOLAT:

   2  'DO we need ANY bread?' — SAVOL →
      ANY
   8  'CAN I HAVE SOME milk?' — ILTIMOS →
      SOME (istisno!)
  20  'There ARE SOME apples.' — TASDIQ →
      SOME

  ⚠ 2 va 8-BANDLAR IKKALASI HAM SAVOL,
  lekin javob boshqa!

     'Do we need ANY bread?' — oddiy savol
     'Can I have SOME milk?' — ILTIMOS

  ILTIMOS va TAKLIFDA 'SOME' ishlatiladi.


──── O'LChOV BIRLIKLARI ────

   9  'a PIECE of cake' = bir bo'lak tort
  12  'a GLASS of water' = bir stakan suv

  ⚠ BOShQA BIRLIKLAR:
     a cup of tea/coffee (piyola)
     a glass of water/milk (stakan)
     a bottle of wine (shisha)
     a carton of milk (paket)
     a packet of biscuits (quti)
     a piece of cake/paper (bo'lak)
     a slice of bread (tilim)
     a bar of chocolate (plitka)
     a loaf of bread (non)

  ⚠ 9-bandda 'cup' XATO — tort piyolada
  bo'lmaydi!
  ⚠ 12-bandda 'packet' XATO — suv qutida
  bo'lmaydi.


──── KO'PLIK ShAKLLARI ────

  10  tomato → TOMATOES
      ⚠ '-o' ga tugagan otga '-ES':
         tomato → tomatoes
         potato → potatoes
         hero → heroes
      (ISTISNO: photo → photos,
       piano → pianos)

  16  knife → KNIVES
      ⚠ '-f/-fe' → '-VES':
         knife → knives
         leaf → leaves
         wife → wives
         wolf → wolves
         life → lives
         shelf → shelves


──── QOLGANLARI ────

   3  'Let's meet for lunch ON Wednesday.'
      KUN bilan 'ON'.

   7  'IS ShE playing with HER friends?'
      KALIT: 'HER friends' → SHE.

  15  'It ISN'T SNOWING today in Boston.'
      ⚠ 'snowing' yolg'iz — yordamchi fe'l
      yo'q, XATO.
      ⚠ 'snows' — Present Simple, 'today'
      ga zid.

  17  'ARE you WORKING late today?'
      'Are you' bosilgan → V-ing kerak.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a fridge    = muzlatgich
  a biscuit   = pechenye
  a shower    = dush
  an exam     = imtihon
  a knife (knives) = pichoq(lar)
  jeans       = jinsi shim
  sandals     = sandal
  a basket    = savat
  a piece     = bo'lak
  a packet    = quti, paket

tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'AT THE MOMENT' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'She' → IS + V-ing.

'am cooking' — 'I' bilan;
'cooks' — Present Simple ('at the moment' ga
zid).

SAVOL → ANY.

'bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun 'a'
ishlatilmaydi.

⚠ 8-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda ILTIMOS,
shuning uchun 'SOME'.

KUN bilan 'ON':
  ON Wednesday / ON Monday / ON Fridays

3-nazorat testida ham bir necha marta
tekshirilgan.

tasks.prompt: 4  ................. eggs are there in the fridge?
tasks.whyUz:
'eggs' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → HOW MANY.

⚠ 14-band bilan solishtiring:
'How MUCH tea?' (tea — sanalmaydigan).

DOIMIY holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'Yuko' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → LIVES ('-s' bilan).

'is living' — vaqtinchalik ma'no berardi
(Coursebook 115-bet: 'I am STAYING with my
uncle').

'biscuits' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → A FEW.

⚠ Gapda 'A' allaqachon bosilgan, demak
'a FEW' yoki 'a LITTLE' kerak.
'a some' — mavjud emas.

18-band bilan solishtiring: 'a LITTLE sugar'.

tasks.prompt: 7  ................. playing with her friends at the moment?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'HER friends' — egalik sifati 'her'
→ ega ham AYOL → SHE.

'at the moment' → Present Continuous
('Is she PLAYING?').

⚠ MUHIM ISTISNO: ILTIMOS va TAKLIFDA savol
bo'lsa ham 'SOME'!

'Can I have SOME milk?' ✓

'a few' — sanaladigan ko'plik bilan
('milk' sanalmaydigan).

2-band bilan solishtiring: oddiy savol → ANY.

'a PIECE of cake' = bir bo'lak tort.

⚠ 'a cup of' — CHOY, QAHVA uchun (tort
piyolada bo'lmaydi!).
⚠ 'a carton of' — SUT uchun.

'How about + ot?' — taklif shakli.

'any' dan keyin KO'PLIK kerak.

⚠ '-O' ga tugagan otga '-ES':
  tomato → tomatOES ✓
  'tomatos' ✗ (yozilishi XATO)

Shunga o'xshash: potato → potatoes,
hero → heroes.
(ISTISNO: photo → photos)

tasks.promptUz: U har kecha dush qabul qiladi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'EVERY NIGHT' — DOIMIY odat
→ PRESENT SIMPLE.

'She' → HAS.

⚠ 1-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
'at the moment' → Continuous.

'have a shower' HARAKAT bo'lsa ham,
'every night' Simple talab qiladi.

tasks.prompt: 12  Could I have a ................. of water, please?
tasks.whyUz:
'a GLASS of water' = bir stakan suv.

⚠ 'a packet of' — pechenye, choy uchun
(suv qutida bo'lmaydi).
⚠ 'a piece of' — tort, qog'oz uchun.

'Could I ...?' — 'Can I ...?' ning
muloyimroq shakli.

tasks.prompt: 13  Rick ................. for his exams this week.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'THIS WEEK' — hozirgi davr
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'Rick' → IS + V-ing.

'am studying' — 'I' bilan;
'studies' — doimiy odat.

'tea' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

⚠ 4-band bilan solishtiring:
'How MANY eggs?' (eggs — sanaladigan).

'How some' — mavjud emas.

KALIT: 'TODAY' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 'snowing' YOLG'IZ — yordamchi fe'l ('is')
yo'q, XATO.
⚠ 'snows' — Present Simple, 'today' ga zid.

⚠ Ob-havo haqida DOIM 'IT'.

tasks.prompt: 16  There aren't any ................. on the table.
tasks.whyUz:
'any' + inkor → KO'PLIK kerak.

⚠ '-F/-FE' → '-VES':
  knife → kniVES ✓
  'knifes' ✗ (yozilishi XATO)

Shunga o'xshash: leaf → leaves,
wife → wives, wolf → wolves, life → lives.

'ARE you' allaqachon bosilgan → V-ING kerak.

'Are you WORKING late today?' — Present
Continuous ('today').

'Are you work' / 'Are you works' — grammatik
XATO.

tasks.prompt: 18  Can I have ................. sugar in my coffee, please?
tasks.whyUz:
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE.

⚠ 6-band bilan solishtiring:
'a FEW biscuits' (sanaladigan).

'any' — iltimosda odatda 'some' yoki
'a little' ishlatiladi.

tasks.promptUz: Kerol odatda jinsi shim va sandal kiyadi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'USUALLY' — DOIMIY odat
→ PRESENT SIMPLE.

'Carol' → WEARS ('-s' bilan).

⚠ 'don't wear' — 'Carol' bilan XATO
(u birlik → 'doesn't').
⚠ 'is wearing' — hozir kiyib turgani.

tasks.prompt: 20  There are ................. apples in the basket.
tasks.whyUz:
'There ARE' + 'apples' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK,
TASDIQ → SOME.

⚠ 'much' va 'a little' — SANALMAYDIGAN otlar
bilan.

tasdiq → some; inkor va savol → any.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR (21 ta bo'sh joy):

   1  Can
   2  How much
   3  How many
   4  is riding
   5  Would you like
   6  any
   7  much
   8  too
   9  some ... any
  10  Do you like
  11  little
  12  is having
  13  is wearing
  14  am listening
  15  is raining
  16  cartons
  17  'm hungry
  18  costs
  19  is having
  20  is shining

⚠ 1, 2, 3, 5, 10-bandlar GAP BOShIDA turadi
→ kitobda BOSh HARF bilan.


──── PRESENT CONTINUOUS (8 ta band!) ────

  Bu testning ASOSIY mavzusi.

 4  'Tom IS RIDING his horse AT THE MOMENT.'
12  'He IS HAVING a shower.'
13  'Tony IS WEARING a nice jacket TODAY.'
14  'Be quiet. I AM LISTENING to my radio
     programme.'
15  'It IS RAINING outside.'
19  'He IS HAVING a cup of tea AT THE
     MOMENT.'
20  'The sun IS SHINING.'

  KALIT SO'ZLAR:
     at the moment, now, today, right now,
     Look!, Listen!, Be quiet!

  QOLIP: am/is/are + fe'l + ING


⚠ 12 va 19-BANDLAR — 'HAVE' NING IKKI XIL
RoLI:

  'He IS HAVING a shower.'  ✓
  'He IS HAVING a cup of tea.'  ✓

  Bu yerda 'have' — HARAKAT (dush qabul
  qilmoq, ichmoq) → Continuous BO'LADI.

  Lekin EGALIK ma'nosida Continuous
  BO'LMAYDI:
     'I HAVE a car.'        ✓
     'I AM HAVING a car.'   ✗


──── SANALADIGAN / SANALMAYDIGAN ────

 2  'HOW MUCH sugar ...?'
    sugar — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH

 3  'HOW MANY tomatoes ...?'
    tomatoes — KO'PLIK → HOW MANY

 7  'How MUCH money have you got?'
    money — SANALMAYDIGAN → MUCH

11  'Just a LITTLE.'
    ham — SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE

  ⚠ JADVAL:
     SANALADIGAN:    how many, a few,
                     many, some, any
     SANALMAYDIGAN:  how much, a little,
                     much, some, any


──── SOME / ANY ────

 6  'There ISN'T ANY Coke in the fridge.'
    INKOR → ANY

 9  'We've got SOME milk, but we haven't got
     ANY biscuits.'
    tasdiq → SOME;  inkor → ANY


──── MULOQOT QOLIPLARI ────

 1  'CAN I have some coffee, please?'
    ⚠ 'Could I ...?' / 'May I ...?' ham
    to'g'ri (muloyimroq).

 5  'WOULD YOU LIKE some ice-cream? —
     Oh yes, please.'
    ⚠ TAKLIF qilish shakli.
    Javobi 'Oh yes, please' — taklifga
    javob.

10  'DO YOU LIKE milk? — No, I hate it.'
    ⚠ UMUMAN yoqtiradimi degan savol.

  ⚠ 5 va 10-BANDLAR FARQI — JUDA MUHIM:

     'WOULD you like ...?' = TAKLIF
        (hozir istaysizmi?)
        Javob: 'Yes, please.' / 'No,
        thanks.'

     'DO you like ...?' = UMUMAN
        yoqtiradimi?
        Javob: 'Yes, I do.' / 'No, I don't.'

     Kitob ikkalasini ataylab yonma-yon
     qo'ygan!


──── LUG'AT ────

 8  'They're TOO expensive.'
    ⚠ 'TOO + sifat' = juda ham (SALBIY
    ma'no — 'shuning uchun sotib ololmayman').
    'very expensive' — shunchaki qimmat.

16  'two CARTONS of milk'
    ⚠ 'bottles' yoki 'litres' ham to'g'ri.
    'a carton of milk' — sut paketi.

17  'I'M HUNGRY. Is there anything to eat?'
    ⚠ 'BE hungry' — 'have hungry' XATO!
    Shunga o'xshash: be thirsty, be cold,
    be hot, be tired.

18  'A meal for two people COSTS about £40.'
    'a meal' — BIRLIK → COSTS ('-s' bilan).
    ⚠ Bu — Present Simple (doimiy narx),
    Continuous EMAS.


⚠ 18-BAND — YAGONA PRESENT SIMPLE:

  Testda 8 ta Present Continuous bor, lekin
  18-band — Present SIMPLE!

  Sababi: narx DOIMIY holat, ayni damdagi
  harakat emas.

     'A meal COSTS £40.'      ✓
     'A meal is costing £40.' ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  sugar      = shakar
  a cupboard = shkaf
  a tomato   = pomidor
  to ride    = minmoq
  ice-cream  = muzqaymoq
  a fridge   = muzlatgich
  expensive  = qimmat
  a biscuit  = pechenye
  ham        = dudlangan go'sht
  a jacket   = kurtka, pidjak
  a programme = ko'rsatuv
  an umbrella = soyabon
  a carton   = paket (sut uchun)
  hungry     = och
  a meal     = ovqat, taom
  to shine   = porlamoq

tasks.whyUz:
ILTIMOS → CAN.

⚠ 'Could I ...?' va 'May I ...?' ham to'g'ri
(muloyimroq shakllar).

'please' iltimosni ko'rsatadi.

tasks.prompt: 2  ................................. sugar is there in the cupboard?
tasks.whyUz:
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

⚠ 3-band bilan solishtiring: 'tomatoes' —
sanaladigan ko'plik → HOW MANY.
tasks.speak: 2  ................................. sugar is there in the cupboard?

tasks.whyUz:
'tomatoes' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → HOW MANY.

⚠ 'tomato' ning ko'pligi — tomatoES
('-o' ga tugagan otga '-es').
Shunga o'xshash: potato → potatoes.

KALIT: 'AT THE MOMENT' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'Tom' — birlik → IS + V-ing.

⚠ 'ride' oxiridagi 'e' tushadi: rid + ing
= RIDING.

⚠ TAKLIF → 'WOULD YOU LIKE ...?'

KALIT: javob 'Oh yes, PLEASE' — taklifga
javob.

10-band bilan solishtiring: 'DO you like
milk?' = umuman yoqtiradimi (javobi
'No, I hate it').

tasks.prompt: 6  There isn't ............................. Coke in the fridge.
tasks.whyUz:
INKOR ('there ISN'T') → ANY.

  tasdiq → some
  inkor  → any
  savol  → any
tasks.speak: 6  There isn't ............................. Coke in the fridge.

tasks.whyUz:
'money' — SANALMAYDIGAN → MUCH.

⚠ 'money' ingliz tilida DOIM sanalmaydigan:
  'How MUCH money?'  ✓
  'How many moneys?' ✗

tasks.prompt: 8  I can't buy these shoes. They're ......... expensive.
tasks.promptUz: Bu poyabzalni sotib ololmayman. Ular juda qimmat.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'TOO + sifat' = HADDAN TASHQARI (SALBIY).

KALIT: 'I CAN'T buy' — demak narx MUAMMO
→ TOO.

  'TOO expensive' = juda qimmat (sotib
     ololmayman)
  'VERY expensive' = shunchaki qimmat
tasks.speak: 8  I can't buy these shoes. They're ......... expensive.

tasks.whyUz:
TASDIQ → SOME.

'milk' — sanalmaydigan, lekin 'some' ham
sanaladigan, ham sanalmaydigan ot bilan
ishlatiladi.

tasks.prompt: 9  but we haven't got ..................... biscuits.   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)
tasks.whyUz:
INKOR ('we HAVEN'T got') → ANY.

Bir gapda ikkalasi: tasdiqda SOME,
inkorda ANY.
tasks.speak: 9  but we haven't got ..................... biscuits.   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ UMUMAN yoqtiradimi → 'DO YOU LIKE ...?'

KALIT: javob 'No, I HATE it' — umumiy
munosabat, hozirgi taklif emas.

5-band bilan solishtiring: 'WOULD you like
some ice-cream?' = TAKLIF.

tasks.prompt: 11  'How much ham do you need?'  'Just a ............ .'
tasks.whyUz:
'ham' — SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE.

⚠ A LITTLE (sanalmaydigan) ↔ A FEW
(sanaladigan):
  'a little milk / sugar / ham'
  'a few biscuits / tomatoes'
tasks.speak: 11  'How much ham do you need?'  'Just a ............ .'

tasks.promptUz: U hozir kela olmaydi. Dush qabul qilyapti.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'NOW' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 'HAVE a shower' — bu HARAKAT, shuning
uchun Continuous BO'LADI.

Lekin EGALIK ma'nosida bo'lmaydi:
'I AM HAVING a car' — XATO.

tasks.promptUz: Toni bugun chiroyli pidjak kiyib olgan.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'TODAY' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 'WEAR' = kiyib turmoq (HOLAT);
'PUT ON' = kiymoq (HARAKAT).

'is wearing' = hozir egnida bor.

tasks.prompt: 14  Be quiet. I ..................................... to my favourite radio programme.
tasks.promptUz: Jim bo'ling. Men sevimli radio ko'rsatuvimni tinglayapman.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'BE QUIET' → hozir sodir bo'lyapti
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'I' → AM + V-ing.

⚠ 'LISTEN TO' — predlog 'to' SHART!
('listen music' XATO)
tasks.speak: 14  Be quiet. I ..................................... to my favourite radio programme.

tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'Take your UMBRELLA' — demak hozir
yomg'ir → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ Ob-havo haqida DOIM 'IT':
'IT is raining / IT is snowing.'

tasks.promptUz: Menga ikkita paket sut olib bera olasizmi?
tasks.whyUz:
'a CARTON of milk' = sut paketi.

⚠ 'bottles' yoki 'litres' ham to'g'ri —
kitob javobni ko'rsatmagan.

'TWO' bo'lgani uchun KO'PLIK: cartonS.

tasks.promptUz: Qornim och. Yeyishga biror narsa bormi?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'BE hungry' — 'HAVE hungry' XATO!

Shunga o'xshash 'be' bilan:
  be thirsty (chanqagan)
  be cold / be hot
  be tired / be afraid

('I have hunger' — o'zbekcha fikrlash.)

tasks.promptUz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 40 funt turadi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TESTDAGI YAGONA PRESENT SIMPLE!

Narx — DOIMIY holat, ayni damdagi harakat
emas:
  'A meal COSTS £40.'      ✓
  'A meal is costing £40.' ✗

'a meal' — BIRLIK → COSTS ('-s' bilan).

tasks.prompt: 19  He ..................... a cup of tea at the moment.
tasks.promptUz: U hozir bir piyola choy ichyapti.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'AT THE MOMENT' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'is DRINKING' ham to'g'ri.

12-band bilan bir xil: 'have' HARAKAT
ma'nosida Continuous bo'ladi.
tasks.speak: 19  He ..................... a cup of tea at the moment.

tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'It's a SUNNY day' — hozir
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

shine → shone → shone (noto'g'ri fe'l),
lekin bu yerda V-ing: SHINING
('e' tushadi).

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C boiling
   2  A How about
   3  C temperature
   4  B book
   5  C cooking
   6  B Do you
   7  C please
   8  A some
   9  A a
  10  B a few


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'It's BOILING hot today.'
    ⚠ 'BOILING hot' — turg'un birikma
    (juda issiq).
    'freezing' — juda SOVUQ, 'hot' ga ZID.
    'sunny hot' — mavjud emas.

    ⚠ Ob-havo kuchaytiruvchilari:
       BOILING hot (juda issiq)
       FREEZING cold (juda sovuq)
       SOAKING wet (shalabbo ho'l)

 2  'HOW ABOUT a ham sandwich?'
    TAKLIF shakli.
    'Would you a sandwich?' — 'like' tushib
       qolgan, XATO.
    'Do you like a ham sandwich?' — g'alati
       (umumiy savol, aniq bitta sendvich
       haqida emas).

 3  'What is the TEMPERATURE in Madrid
     today? — It's 20°C.'
    KALIT: javob GRADUS → TEMPERATURE.
    'weather' bo'lsa javob 'It's sunny'
       bo'lardi.
    'season' = fasl (yoz, qish).

 4  'Don't forget to BOOK a table.'
    ⚠ 'BOOK a table' = stol band qilmoq.
    'order a table' — XATO ('order' ovqat
       uchun).
    'close a table' — mantiqsiz.

 5  'What is she doing? — She's COOKING
     dinner.'
    'cook dinner' = kechki ovqat pishirmoq.
    'frying' = qovurmoq (aniq usul,
       'dinner' bilan g'alati).
    'doing dinner' — mavjud emas.

 6  'DO YOU like your steak? — Yes, it's
     delicious.'
    KALIT: javob 'YES, IT'S DELICIOUS' —
    steyk ALLAQAChON oldida, u yeb ko'rgan.
    → hozirgi fikrini so'rayapti → DO YOU.

    'Would you like your steak?' — taklif,
       lekin steyk allaqachon berilgan.

 7  'Can I help you? — Yes, PLEASE.'
    Bo'sh joydan keyin NUQTA bor — demak
    TO'LIQ javob kerak.
    'Yes, I'd like ...' — davomi kerak
       bo'lardi (nima?).
    'Yes, I like it' — savolga mos kelmaydi.

 8  'Can I have SOME water, please?'
    ⚠ ILTIMOS va TAKLIFDA savol bo'lsa ham
    'SOME' ishlatiladi!
    'water' — sanalmaydigan, 'a few' mos
       kelmaydi.
    'any water' — bu yerda g'alati (iltimos).

 9  'We'd like A bottle of red wine.'
    'bottle' — BIRLIK sanaladigan ot → A.
    'some bottle' / 'any bottle' — XATO.

10  'There are A FEW strawberries in the
     fridge.'
    'strawberries' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK
       → A FEW.
    'much' / 'a little' — sanalmaydigan
       otlar bilan.
    ('There ARE' ham ko'plikni tasdiqlaydi.)


⚠ 8-BAND — MUHIM ISTISNO:

  Odatda SAVOLDA 'any' ishlatiladi:
     'Have you got ANY water?'

  Lekin ILTIMOS va TAKLIFDA 'some':
     'Can I have SOME water, please?'
     'Would you like SOME tea?'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  boiling hot = juda issiq
  freezing   = juda sovuq
  How about ...? = ... bo'lsa-chi?
  a ham sandwich = dudlangan go'shtli
               sendvich
  temperature = harorat
  a season   = fasl
  to book a table = stol band qilmoq
  to fry     = qovurmoq
  a steak    = steyk
  delicious  = mazali
  wine       = vino
  a strawberry = qulupnay
  a few      = bir nechta
  a little   = ozgina

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'BOILING hot' — turg'un birikma
(juda issiq).

'freezing' = juda SOVUQ — 'hot' ga ZID!
'sunny hot' — mavjud emas.

O'xshash: FREEZING cold, SOAKING wet.

'HOW ABOUT + ot/V-ing?' — TAKLIF shakli.

'Would you a sandwich?' — 'LIKE' tushib
qolgan, XATO ('Would you LIKE ...?').
'Do you like a ham sandwich?' — umumiy savol,
aniq bitta sendvich taklifi emas.

KALIT: javob GRADUS ('20°C') → TEMPERATURE.

'weather' bo'lsa javob 'It's sunny/rainy'
bo'lardi.
'season' = fasl (yoz, qish, bahor, kuz).

⚠ 'BOOK a table' = stol band qilmoq
(oldindan buyurtma).

'ORDER' — OVQAT buyurtma qilish uchun
('order a steak').
'close a table' — mantiqsiz.

'book' — bu yerda FE'L ('kitob' emas).

'COOK dinner' = kechki ovqat pishirmoq.

'frying' = qovurmoq — aniq usul, butun
'dinner' bilan g'alati ('frying eggs' ✓).
'doing dinner' — mavjud emas.

KALIT: javob 'Yes, IT'S DELICIOUS' — steyk
ALLAQACHON oldida, u yeb ko'rgan.
→ hozirgi fikri so'ralyapti → DO YOU.

'Would you like your steak?' — TAKLIF, lekin
steyk allaqachon berilgan.

⚠ Bo'sh joydan keyin NUQTA bor — demak
TO'LIQ javob kerak.

'Yes, PLEASE.' ✓ — to'liq javob.
'Yes, I'd like ...' — davomi kerak (nima?).
'Yes, I like it' — savolga mos kelmaydi.

⚠ MUHIM ISTISNO: ILTIMOS va TAKLIFDA savol
bo'lsa ham 'SOME' ishlatiladi!

  'Can I have SOME water?'  ✓
  'Would you like SOME tea?' ✓

'a few' — sanaladigan ko'plik bilan
('water' sanalmaydigan).

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'WHAT'S THE WEATHER LIKE today?'
    B: 'It's warm and sunny.'

 2  A: 'WOULD YOU LIKE SOME WINE?'
    B: 'No, thanks. I don't like wine.'

 3  A: 'HOW MUCH IS IT?'
    B: 'It's two pounds seventy.'

 4  A: 'CAN I TAKE YOUR order, please?'
    B: 'Yes. I'd like grilled fish with
        rice.'

 5  A: 'CAN I HELP YOU?'
    B: 'Yes, please. I'm looking for a
        skirt.'


QANDAY TOPILADI:

 1  Gapning oxirida 'TODAY?' allaqachon
    bosilgan, javob esa OB-HAVO.
    → 'What's the weather like today?'

    ⚠ 'What's the weather LIKE?' — 'like'
    SHART!
    'How is the weather?' ham to'g'ri.

 2  Javob: 'NO, THANKS. I don't like wine.'
    'No, thanks' — TAKLIFGA javob.
    → 'Would you like some wine?'

    ⚠ 1-mashqning 5 va 10-bandlari bilan
    bir xil qoida.

 3  Javob: 'It's TWO POUNDS SEVENTY.' —
    NARX.
    → 'How much is it?'

    ⚠ 'How much' — narx so'rash uchun ham
    ishlatiladi.

 4  Gapning oxirida 'ORDER, PLEASE?'
    allaqachon bosilgan.
    → 'CAN I TAKE YOUR order, please?'

    ⚠ Restoranda ofitsiantning savoli.
    'May I take your order?' ham to'g'ri.

 5  Javob: 'Yes, please. I'm LOOKING FOR a
    skirt.' — do'konda.
    → 'Can I help you?'

    ⚠ 2-mashqning 7-bandi ham shu savol edi!


⚠ 4 va 5-BANDLAR — XIZMAT ChILAR IBORASI:

  DO'KONDA:
     Sotuvchi: 'Can I help you?'
     Xaridor: 'Yes, please. I'm looking for
              ...'

  RESTORANDA:
     Ofitsiant: 'Can I take your order?'
     Mijoz: 'Yes. I'd like ...'

  ⚠ 'I'D LIKE ...' = 'I would like ...'
  — buyurtma berishning muloyim shakli.
  ('I want ...' qo'polroq eshitiladi.)


DIQQAT — 'LOOK FOR':
  'I'm LOOKING FOR a skirt.' = qidiryapman

  'look FOR' = qidirmoq
  'look AT' = qaramoq
  'look AFTER' = qaramoq, parvarish qilmoq


DIQQAT — 'TWO POUNDS SEVENTY':
  £2.70 → 'two pounds seventy'
  Funt va pens birga o'qiladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  What's the weather like? = Ob-havo qanday?
  warm       = iliq
  wine       = vino
  a pound    = funt (pul)
  to take an order = buyurtma olmoq
  grilled    = panjarada pishirilgan
  rice       = guruch
  to look for = qidirmoq
  a skirt    = yubka

wordFormation.ruleUz: ⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS ↔ PRESENT SIMPLE — KALIT SO'ZLAR

items.derived: at the moment, now, today, this week
He IS HAVING a shower / a cup of tea.
Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

sentencePatterns.formula: [ega] AM/IS/ARE + [fe'l]ING + [at the moment / today / this week].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is cooking dinner at the moment. Rick is studying this week.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hozir ovqat pishiryapti. Rik bu hafta tayyorlanyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — kalit so'zlar:
at the moment, now, today, this week.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She has a shower every night. Carol usually wears jeans.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U har kecha dush qabul qiladi. Kerol odatda jinsi kiyadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — doimiy odat.
3-shaxs birlikda '-s' qo'shiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many eggs are there? How much tea do you want?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nechta tuxum bor? Qancha choy xohlaysiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Javoblari ham farq qiladi:
a FEW (sanaladigan) / a LITTLE (sanalmaydigan).

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I have SOME + [ot], please?   ↔   Do we need ANY + [ot]?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I have some milk? Do we need any bread?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga sut bersangiz bo'ladimi? Bizga non kerakmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ ILTIMOS → SOME (savol bo'lsa ham);
ODDIY SAVOL → ANY.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a piece of cake, a glass of water, a cup of tea, a carton of milk
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: bir bo'lak tort, bir stakan suv, bir piyola choy, bir paket sut
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sanalmaydigan otni 'sanash' uchun
o'lchov birligi ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [ega] AM/IS/ARE + [fe'l]ING + AT THE MOMENT / NOW / TODAY.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom is riding his horse at the moment. The sun is shining.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom hozir ot minyapti. Quyosh charaqlayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ayni damda sodir
bo'layotgan harakat.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How much sugar is there? How many tomatoes are there?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qancha shakar bor? Nechta pomidor bor?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Javoblari ham farq qiladi:
a LITTLE (sanalmaydigan) / a FEW (sanaladigan).

sentencePatterns.formula: WOULD YOU LIKE SOME + [ot]?  —  Yes, please. / No, thanks.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like some ice-cream? — Oh yes, please.

sentencePatterns.formula: DO YOU LIKE + [ot]?  —  Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you like milk? — No, I hate it.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ UMUMAN yoqtiradimi — taklif EMAS.
'Would you like ...?' bilan chalkashtirmang.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qornim och. Yeyishga biror narsa bormi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bu holatlar 'BE' bilan:
'I HAVE hungry' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's the weather LIKE?  —  It's warm and sunny. / It's boiling hot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's the weather like today? — It's warm and sunny.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun ob-havo qanday? — Iliq va quyoshli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'LIKE' SHART.
Kuchaytiruvchilar: BOILING hot, FREEZING cold.
